faq.q: How much does LARA LAW FIRM charge?
faq.a: LARA LAW FIRM publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does LARA LAW FIRM offer a free consultation?
faq.a: LARA LAW FIRM does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does LARA LAW FIRM have offices?
faq.a: LARA LAW FIRM publishes two offices, in Tucson and Phoenix. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at LARA LAW FIRM?
faq.a: LARA LAW FIRM names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from.
